body:
I was able to reproduce this error on an `Adreno 650` GPU using the export template. 
_(I noticed it two weeks ago, it doesn't seem to be critical.)_

```
E 0:00:00:238   texture_create: Data for slice index 0 (mapped to layer 0) differs in size (supplied: 16) than what is required by the format (32).
  <C++ Error>   Condition "(uint32_t)data[i].size() != required_size" is true. Returning: RID()
  <C++ Source>  ./servers/rendering/rendering_device.cpp:963 @ texture_create()
```

------------

Edit:
I could also see `VK_ERROR_SURFACE_LOST_KHR` on my device when closing the app.

```
E 0:00:00:901   command_queue_execute_and_present: QueuePresentKHR failed with error: VK_ERROR_SURFACE_LOST_KHR
  <C++ Error>   Condition "err != VK_SUCCESS && err != VK_SUBOPTIMAL_KHR" is true. Returning: FAILED
  <C++ Source>  drivers/vulkan/rendering_device_driver_vulkan.cpp:2818 @ command_queue_execute_and_present()
```

> * Not reproducible in: 4.5 dev 5 and On my device I can reproduce both warnings even in `4.5 dev 2`. In `4.5 dev 1` only `VK_ERROR_SURFACE_LOST_KHR`. -------------- I tried running [bisecting_regressions](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/latest/contributing/workflow/bisecting_regressions.html). However, I had to abort because I encountered a crash condition. Perhaps I need to build the editor additionally.

-----------

**Update:**

tested `4.4-dev1` to `dev7`

- **dev 1 - 4:** `ERROR: Condition "err != VK_SUCCESS && err != VK_SUBOPTIMAL_KHR" is true. Returning: FAILED`
- **dev 5 - 7:** `ERROR: QueuePresentKHR failed with error: VK_ERROR_SURFACE_LOST_KHR`

In `dev1` to `dev3` the error messages were issued somewhat less frequently. 
Minimize the app several times, press the Home/Task button and reactivate the app.

----------

`err != VK_SUBOPTIMAL_KHR` also reproducible in `v4.3.stable.official.77dcf97d8`
If it is the same error as `VK_ERROR_SURFACE_LOST_KHR`, then we can ignore both errors for now as long as they are not critical.
